title: Marduk/Quotes
summary:
"America. I never imagined the Casterwills would flee this far."
- Murdock to Kiel, (The Casterwill Connection)

"The old man is hiding. There."
- Murdock to Kiel, (The Casterwill Connection)

"Master Kiel, I will track them down without fail."
- Murdock to Kiel, (The Titan in the Temple of Sun)

"You will never know for sure, boy! Your time is up!"
- Murdock to Den and Lok, (The Titan in the Temple of Sun)

"Looks like four sets of footprints, Hmm recent."
- Murdock to his Casterwill Hunters, (Words from Eathon)

"We can't let them escape. Wait until they are in a corner."
- Murdock to his Casterwill Hunters, (Words from Eathon)
